note: Rule IDs are FROZEN as of this version. Do not renumber without a version bump and team-wide notice.

confidence_threshold.note: If OCR confidence for a field's evidence is below this, result = REVIEW regardless of validation outcome (unless evidence is fully absent, in which case FAIL).

date_role_policy.rule: A detected date is not sufficient evidence of the declaration type. The extraction must identify date_role. An unresolved date role (null or 'unclear') MUST result in REVIEW - it must never be inferred or defaulted to 'manufacturing' or 'best_before_use_by'.

rules.requirement: Name and address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1) - manufacturer/packer/importer declaration. Sub-clause letter not independently verified against the current consolidated text - VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE.

outputs.review: Manufacturer/packer/importer text detected but confidence too low to confirm.

rules.requirement: Common or generic name of the commodity must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1) - generic/common name declaration. Sub-clause letter not independently verified - VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE.

outputs.review: Text present but could not reliably identify the commodity name (e.g. only brand/slogan visible).

rules.requirement: Net quantity must be declared with a standard unit.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1) - net quantity declaration. Sub-clause letter not independently verified - VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE.

validation.note: unit_status distinguishes a confirmed-absent unit (FAIL - the declaration is genuinely incomplete) from an ambiguous/unclear unit (REVIEW - extraction couldn't tell). Do not default an unclear case to FAIL.

outputs.pass: Net quantity and valid unit detected.
outputs.fail: Net quantity value found but no unit was declared on the package.
outputs.review: Net quantity detected but unit is ambiguous or extraction confidence is low.

rules.requirement: Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes) must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1) - MRP/retail sale price declaration. Sub-clause letter not independently verified - VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE.

validation.note: context_confirmed must be explicitly true if multiple price-like values are detected on the package. A price cannot be assumed to be MRP just because it was found.

outputs.review: A price was detected but MRP context is uncertain (e.g. multiple prices present, none confirmed as MRP).

rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture (or import/packing, as applicable) must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) - date of manufacture declaration, subject to carve-outs for food articles (Prevention of Food Adulteration Act / FSSAI), seeds, cosmetics, and spare parts under warranty per the 2023 amendment. VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE for exact current carve-out list.

validation.note: evidence.date_role must be explicitly 'manufacturing'. If date_role is null or 'unclear', this MUST return REVIEW, never PASS or an inferred classification.

outputs.pass: Manufacturing/packing date detected and confirmed as manufacturing date.
outputs.review: A date was detected but its role (manufacturing vs. best-before/use-by) could not be reliably established.

rules.requirement: Name, address, telephone/email of the person or office to be contacted for consumer complaints must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1) - consumer care declaration. Sub-clause letter not independently verified - VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE.

outputs.review: Partial consumer care information found (e.g. only a name, no contact method).

rules.requirement: Country of origin must be declared for imported products.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1) - country of origin declaration for imported packages. Sub-clause letter not independently verified - VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE.

outputs.pass: Country of origin detected for imported product.
outputs.fail: Product flagged as imported but no country of origin declared.
outputs.review: Import status or country-of-origin evidence is ambiguous.
outputs.na: Product not identified as imported; requirement does not apply.

rules.requirement: For commodities that may become unfit for consumption over time, the 'best before' or 'use by' date, month, and year must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(da) - best before/use by declaration for applicable commodities. Confirmed to exist in the Rule 6 text via secondary/legal-database source (indiankanoon.org); recommend VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE (Dept. of Consumer Affairs) before final submission.

validation.note: evidence.date_role must be explicitly 'best_before_use_by'. If date_role is null or 'unclear', this MUST return REVIEW, never PASS or an inferred classification.

outputs.pass: Best before/use by date detected and confirmed.
outputs.fail: Product may expire but no best before/use by date found.
outputs.review: A date was detected but its role (manufacturing vs. best-before/use-by) could not be reliably established.
outputs.na: Product not identified as perishable/time-sensitive; requirement does not apply.

rules.requirement: The unit sale price (price per gram/kg, per cm/m, per ml/l, or per number/unit as applicable) must be declared, unless an exemption applies.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(11) (as substituted by the 2022 Amendment Rules, effective 1 Oct 2022) - unit sale price declaration. Confirmed exemptions found via secondary sources: (1) not required where retail sale price equals unit sale price [2nd proviso, Rule 6(11)], (2) not required on wholesale packages [Rule 2(r)], (3) not required for Combination/Group/Multi-Piece Packages [2023 amendment], (4) not required on e-commerce listings [Rule 6(10)]. VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE before final submission - these exemptions are drawn from legal-commentary sources, not the bare gazetted text.

applicability.note: Applicability depends on package/commodity type (single retail package sold by weight/length/volume/number, not wholesale/combination/group/multi-piece, and RSP != USP). This is a compound condition - MVP should treat it as a single upstream boolean (product.requires_unit_sale_price) rather than re-deriving all sub-conditions in the rule engine, unless Person 1/3 want to encode the sub-conditions separately.

outputs.fail: Unit sale price is applicable but not found.
outputs.review: Applicability or evidence for unit sale price is ambiguous.
outputs.na: Unit sale price does not apply to this package (e.g. RSP equals USP, wholesale/combination/group/multi-piece package, or e-commerce listing).

rules.requirement: Where relevant to the commodity category, dimensions (e.g. length, area) must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. Some commodity categories may have dimension-based declaration requirements under Schedule provisions of the LMPC Rules, but this has not been confirmed against a primary source for this project. VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE before treating this as a confirmed general requirement - treat as commodity-category-specific, not universal.

outputs.pass: Dimensions detected for a commodity category where they are relevant.
outputs.fail: Dimensions are relevant for this commodity but not found.
outputs.review: Relevance of dimensions to this commodity category is unclear.
outputs.na: Dimensions are not relevant to this commodity category.

rules.requirement: Certain declarations (notably MRP and net quantity) are expected to appear together on the Principal Display Panel, presented legibly, rather than scattered across the package.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 7 - Principal Display Panel provisions, and Rule 8 - manner/size of declaration. Real requirement, confirmed to exist, but exact operative text, current wording, and precise co-location/legibility thresholds are NOT independently verified. VERIFY AGAINST CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE. Do not invent a universal rule such as 'MRP must always be at position X' - no such specific claim is made or implemented here.
rules.status: EXPERIMENTAL - NOT SCORED. Excluded from the compliance score denominator regardless of applicability or outcome.

validation.note: Verifying true panel co-location and legibility from bounding boxes/OCR confidence alone is unreliable without panel-boundary detection, which is out of scope for this MVP. Implement only if time permits. If the system cannot reliably determine the relevant panel/placement, return REVIEW, never FAIL - this rule must never contribute to a hard FAIL or to the compliance score.

outputs.pass: MRP and net quantity appear co-located and legible, consistent with Principal Display Panel expectations. Informational only.
outputs.fail: Not used - this rule cannot produce a scored FAIL; see validation.required and status.
outputs.review: Placement/legibility could not be reliably confirmed from available evidence. Informational only.
